packages.label: בְּרָכָה וְנִשֵּׂאת וְנוֹשֵׂאת
packages.reason: ברכה (blessing) and נשאת ונושאת (carried-and-carries) are two expressions of the same essential reality. The Torah derives the word ברכה as an acronym for 'כִּי רוּחַ הַחַיָּה בָּאוֹפַנִּים' (Ezekiel 1:20), which is precisely the principle of נשאת ונושאת — the quality of simultaneously bearing and being borne, as embodied by the Merkavah. The blessing given to the drink-carrier IS the נשאת ונושאת quality: he carries the drink, and the drink in turn elevates him. These two nodes are not cause-and-effect — they are two names for the same spiritual principle of mutual elevation.
